subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Revolution
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Revolution"** means a dramatic and wide-reaching change in conditions, attitudes, or operation. (क्रांति)

 
 
• **Example: **The industrial** revolution** changed the face of manufacturing forever.
 
 
 
• **"Gyration" **refers to a rapid movement in a circle or spiral; a whirling motion. (घूमाव)
 
 
• **Example: **The **gyration** of the dancer captivated the audience.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Revolution'** is **'Gyration'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Order** (क्रम): The arrangement or disposition of people or things in relation to each other according to a particular sequence, pattern, or method.

 
 
• **Example:** The students were asked to stand in alphabetical order.
 
 
 
• **Harmony** (सामंजस्य): The combination of simultaneously sounded musical notes to produce a pleasing effect.
 
 
• **Example:** The choir sang in perfect harmony.
 
 
 
• **Stagnation** (स्थिरता): The state of not flowing or moving; lack of activity, growth, or development.
 
 
• **Example:** Economic stagnation can lead to high unemployment rates.
